pli-tv-kd19:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāramātu pāsāde.
pli-tv-kd19:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadah' uposathe bhikkhusaṃghaparivuto nisinno hoti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.1.3: atha kho āyasmā Ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante paṭhame yāme uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten' añjalim paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd19:1.1.4: abhikkantā bhante ratti, nikkhanto paṭhamo yāmo, ciranisinno bhikkhusaṃgho,
pli-tv-kd19:1.1.5: uddisatu bhante bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ pātimokkhan ti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.1.7: dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante majjhime yāme uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd19:1.1.10: dutiyam pi kho bhagavā tuṇhī ahosi.
pli-tv-kd19:1.1.11: tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante pacchime yāme uddhate aruṇe nandimukhiyā rattiyā uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd19:1.1.12: nikkhanto pacchimo yāmo uddhataṃ aruṇaṃ nandimukhī ratti, ciranisinno . . .
pli-tv-kd19:1.2.1: atha kho āyasmato Mahāmoggallānassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd19:1.2.2: kan nu kho bhagavā puggalaṃ sandāya evam āha:
pli-tv-kd19:1.2.4: atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno sabbāvantaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manas' ākāsi.
pli-tv-kd19:1.2.5: addasā kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ dussīlaṃ pāpadhammaṃ asucisaṃkassarasamācāraṃ paṭicchannakammantaṃ assamaṇaṃ samaṇapaṭiññaṃ abrahmacāriṃ brahmacāripaṭiññaṃ antopūtiṃ avassutaṃ kasambukajātaṃ majjhe bhikkhusaṃghassa nisinnaṃ,
pli-tv-kd19:1.2.6: disvāna yena so puggalo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ puggalaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd19:1.2.8: n' atthi te bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāso 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.2.9: evaṃ vutte so puggalo tuṇhī ahosi.
pli-tv-kd19:1.2.10: dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd19:1.2.13: dutiyam pi kho so puggalo tuṇhī ahosi.
pli-tv-kd19:1.2.14: tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd19:1.2.17: tatiyam pi kho so puggalo tuṇhī ahosi.
pli-tv-kd19:1.2.18: atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā bahi dvārakoṭṭhakā nikkhāmetvā sucighaṭikaṃ datvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd19:1.2.21: uddisatu bhante bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ pātimokkhan ti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.2.22: acchariyaṃ Moggallāna abbhutaṃ Moggallāna, yāva bāhāgahaṇāpi nāma so moghapuriso āgamessatīti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.1: aṭṭh' ime bhikkhave mahāsamudde acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ye disvā-disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.3: mahāsamuddo bhikkhave anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro na āyataken' eva papāto.
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.4: yam pi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro na āyataken' eva papāto,
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave mahāsamudde paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo yaṃ disvā-disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.6: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave mahāsamuddo ṭhitadhammo velaṃ nātivattati.
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.7: yam pi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo ṭhitadhammo velaṃ nātivattati,
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.9: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave mahāsamuddo na matena kuṇapena saṃvasati, yaṃ hoti mahāsamudde mataṃ kuṇapaṃ taṃ khippaṃ ñeva tīraṃ vāheti thalaṃ ussādeti .
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.10: yaṃ pi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo na matena kuṇapena saṃvasati, yaṃ hoti mahāsamudde mataṃ kuṇapaṃ . . . ussādeti ,
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.12: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yā kāci mahānadiyo seyyath' īdaṃ: Gaṅgā Yamunā Aciravatī Sarabhū Mahī, tā mahāsamuddaṃ pattā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni mahāsamuddo tv eva saṃkhaṃ gacchanti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.13: yam pi bhikkhave yā kāci mahānadiyo . . . gacchanti,
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.15: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yā ca loke savantiyo mahāsamuddaṃ appenti yā ca antalikkhā dhārā papatanti na tena mahāsamuddassa ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā puññāyati.
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.16: yam pi bhikkhave yā ca loke . . . paññāyati,
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.18: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave mahāsamuddo ekaraso loṇaraso.
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.19: yam pi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo ekaraso loṇaraso,
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.21: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave mahāsamuddo bahuratano anekaratano, tatr' imāni ratanāni seyyath' īdaṃ: muttā maṇi veḷuriyo saṅkho silā pavāḷaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ lohitaṅko masāragallaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.22: yam pi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo bahuratano . . . masāragallaṃ,
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.24: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatr' ime bhūtā: timi timiṃgalo timitimiṃgalo asurā nāgā gandhabbā, santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikāpi attabhāvā dviyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā tiyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā catuyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā pañcayojanasatikāpi attabhāvā.
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.25: yam pi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ . . . attabhāvā,
pli-tv-kd19:1.3.27: ime kho bhikkhave mahāsamudde aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ye disvā-disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.1: evam eva kho bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ye disvā-disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro na āyataken' eva pāpato,
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.4: evam eva kho bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā na āyataken' eva aññāpaṭivedho.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.5: yam pi bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā . . . aññāpaṭivedho
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.6: ayaṃ bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo yaṃ disvā-disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo ṭhitadhammo velaṃ nātivattati,
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.8: evam eva kho bhikkhave yaṃ mayā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ taṃ mama sāvakā jīvitahetu pi nātikkamanti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.9: yam pi bhikkhave mayā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ taṃ mama sāvakā jīvitahetu pi nātikkamanti,
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.10: ayaṃ bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye dutiyo . . . abhiramanti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.11: seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo na matena kuṇapena saṃvasati yaṃ hoti mahāsamudde mataṃ kuṇapaṃ taṃ khippaṃ ñeva tīraṃ vāheti thalaṃ ussādeti ,
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.12: evam eva kho bhikkhave yo so puggalo dussīlo pāpadhammo asucisaṃkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambukajāto, na tena saṃgho saṃvasati khippaṃ eva ca naṃ sannipatitvā ukkhipati, kiñ cāpi so hoti majjhe bhikkhusaṃghassa nisinno atha kho so ārakā 'va saṃghamhā saṃgho ca tena.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.13: yam pi bhikkhave yo so puggalo dussīlo . . . saṃgho ca tena,
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.14: ayaṃ bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye tatiyo . . . abhiramanti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.15: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yā kāci mahānadiyo seyyath' īdaṃ: Gaṅgā Yamunā Aciravatī Sarabhū Mahī tā mahāsamuddaṃ pattā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni mahāsamuddo tv eva saṃkhaṃ gacchanti,
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.17: cattāro 'me vaṇṇā khattiyā brāhmaṇā vessā suddā te tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā tv eva saṃkhaṃ gacchanti, yaṃ pi bhikkhave cattāro 'me vaṇṇā . . . saṃkhaṃ gacchanti,
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.18: ayaṃ bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye catuttho . . . abhiramanti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.19: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yā ca loke savantiyo mahāsamuddaṃ appenti yā ca antalikkhā dhārā papatanti na tena mahāsamuddassa ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati,
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.20: evam eva kho bhikkhave bahū ce pi bhikkhū anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyanti na tena nibbānadhātuyā ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.21: yam pi bhikkhave bahū ce pi . . . pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati,
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.22: ayaṃ bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pañcamo . . . abhiramanti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.24: evam eva kho bhikkhave ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.25: yam pi bhikkhave ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso,
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.26: ayaṃ bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye chaṭṭho . . . abhiramanti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.27: seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo bahuratano anekaratano, tatr' imāni ratanāni seyyath' īdaṃ: muttā maṇi veḷuriyo saṅkho silā pavāḷaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ lohitaṅko masāragallaṃ,
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.28: evam eva kho bhikkhave ayaṃ dhammavinayo bahuratano anekaratano, tatr' imāni ratanāni seyyath' īdaṃ: cattāro satipaṭṭhānā cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro iddhipādā pañc' indriyāni pañca balāni satta bojjhaṅgāni ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.29: yam pi bhikkhave ayaṃ dhammavinayo bahuratano . . . ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo,
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.30: ayaṃ bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye sattamo . . . abhiramanti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.31: seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatr' ime bhūtā: timi timiṃgalo timitimiṃgalo asurā nāgā gandhabbā, santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikāpi attabhāvā dviyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā tiyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā catuyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā pañcayojanasatikāpi attabhāvā,
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.32: evam eva kho bhikkhave ayaṃ dhammavinayo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatr' ime bhūtā: sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno sakadāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno anāgāmī anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno arahā arahattāya paṭipanno.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.33: yam pi bhikkhave ayaṃ dhammavinayo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ . . . arahattāya paṭipanno,
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.34: ayaṃ bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye aṭṭhamo . . . abhiramanti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.35: ime kho bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ye disvā-disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramantīti.
pli-tv-kd19:1.4.36: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd19:2.1.2: na dān' āhaṃ bhikkhave itoparaṃ uposathaṃ karissāmi pātimokkhaṃ uddisissāmi,
pli-tv-kd19:2.1.3: tumheva dāni bhikkhave itoparaṃ uposathaṃ kareyyātha pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyyātha.
pli-tv-kd19:2.1.4: aṭṭhānam etaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso yaṃ tathāgato aparisuddhāya parisāya uposathaṃ kareyya pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyya.
pli-tv-kd19:2.1.5: na ca bhikkhave sāpattikena pātimokkhaṃ sotabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:2.1.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave yo sāpattiko pātimokkhaṃ suṇāti tassa pātimokkhaṃ ṭhapetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:2.1.9: tadah' uposathe cātuddase vā pannarase vā tasmiṃ puggale sammukhībhūte saṃghamajjhe udāharitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:2.1.11: itthannāmo puggalo sāpattiko, tassa pātimokkhaṃ ṭhapemi na tasmiṃ sammukhībhūte pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabban ti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd19:3.1.2: n' amhe koci jānātīti sāpattikā 'va pātimokkhaṃ suṇanti.
pli-tv-kd19:3.1.4: itthannāmo ca itthannāmo ca āvuso chabbaggiyā bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd19:3.1.5: n 'amhe koci jānātīti sāpattikā 'va pātimokkhaṃ suṇantīti.
pli-tv-kd19:3.1.7: therā kira bhikkhū paracittaviduno amhe bhikkhūnaṃ ārocenti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.1.8: itthannāmo ca itthannāmo ca āvuso chabbaggiyā bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd19:3.1.9: n' amhe koci jānātīti sāpattikā 'va pātimokkhaṃ suṇantīti.
pli-tv-kd19:3.1.11: pur' amhākaṃ pesalā bhikkhū pātimokkhaṃ ṭhapentīti
pli-tv-kd19:3.1.12: paṭigacc' eva suddhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anāpattikānaṃ avatthusmiṃ akāraṇe pātimokkhaṃ ṭhapenti.
pli-tv-kd19:3.1.13: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.1.14: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū suddhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anāpattikānaṃ avatthusmiṃ akāraṇe pātimokkhaṃ ṭhapessantīti.
pli-tv-kd19:3.1.15: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:3.1.16: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhū suddhānaṃ . . . ṭhapentīti.
pli-tv-kd19:3.1.20: na bhikkhave suddhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anāpattikānaṃ avatthusmiṃ akāraṇe pātimokkhaṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:3.2.1: ekaṃ bhikkhave adhammikaṃ pātimokkhaṭhapanaṃ ekaṃ dhammikaṃ.

pli-tv-kd19:3.3.82: na sikkhaṃ paccakkhātako tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti, na sikkhaṃ paccakkhātakathā vippakatā hoti,
pli-tv-kd19:3.3.83: dhammikaṃ sāmaggiṃ upeti, na dhammikaṃ sāmaggiṃ paccādiyati, na dhammikāya sāmaggiyā paccādānakathā vippakatā hoti,
pli-tv-kd19:3.3.84: na sīlavipattiyā diṭṭhasutaparisaṅkito hoti, na ācāravipattiyā diṭṭhasutaparisaṅkito hoti, na diṭṭhivipattiyā diṭṭhasutaparisaṅkito hoti.
pli-tv-kd19:3.3.87: pārājiko tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti, pārājikakathā vippakatā hoti,
pli-tv-kd19:3.3.88: sikkhaṃ paccakkhātako tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti, sikkhaṃ paccakkhātakathā vippakatā hoti,
pli-tv-kd19:3.3.89: dhammikaṃ sāmaggiṃ na upeti, dhammikaṃ sāmaggiṃ paccādiyati, dhammikāya sāmaggiyā paccādānakathā vippakatā hoti,
pli-tv-kd19:3.3.90: sīlavipattiyā diṭṭhasutaparisaṅkito hoti, ācāravipattiyā diṭṭhasutaparisaṅkito hoti, diṭṭhivipattiyā diṭṭhasutaparisaṅkito hoti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.1.1: kathaṃ pārājiko tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.2: idha bhikkhave yehi ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi pārājikassa dhammassa ajjhāpatti hoti tehi ākārehi tehi liṅgehi tehi nimittehi bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.3: na h' eva kho bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjantaṃ, api c' añño bhikkhu bhikkhussa āroceti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.4: itthannāmo āvuso bhikkhu pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpanno 'ti,
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.5: na h' eva kho bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjantaṃ, nāpi añño bhikkhu bhikkhussa āroceti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.6: itthannāmo āvuso bhikkhu pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpanno 'ti, api ca so 'va bhikkhussa āroceti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.8: ākaṅkhamāno bhikkhave bhikkhu tena diṭṭhena tena sutena tāya parisaṅkāya tadah' uposathe cātuddase vā pannarase vā tasmiṃ puggale sammukhībhūte saṃghamajjhe udāhareyya:
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.10: itthannāmo puggalo pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpanno, tassa pātimokkhaṃ ṭhapemi, na tasmiṃ sammukhībhūte pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabban ti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.12: bhikkhussa pātimokkhe ṭhapite parisā vuṭṭhāti dasannaṃ antarāyānaṃ aññatarena,
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.13: rājantarāyena vā corantarāyena vā agyantar. vā udakantar. vā manussantar. vā amanussantar. vā vāḷantar. vā siriṃsapantar. vā jīvitantar. vā brahmacariyantarāyena vā.
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.14: ākaṅkhamāno bhikkhave bhikkhu tasmiṃ āvāse aññatarasmiṃ vā āvāse tasmiṃ puggale sammukhībhūte saṃghamajjhe udāhareyya:
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.16: itthannāmassa puggalassa pārājikakathā vippakatā, taṃ vatthuṃ avinicchitaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.17: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho taṃ vatthuṃ vinicchineyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.18: evañ ce taṃ labhetha icc etaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.19: no ce labhetha tadah' uposathe cātuddase vā pannarase vā tasmiṃ puggale sammukhībhūte saṃghamajjhe udāharitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.21: itthannāmassa puggalassa pārājikakathā vippakatā, taṃ vatthuṃ avinicchitaṃ,
pli-tv-kd19:3.4.22: tassa pātimokkhaṃ ṭhapemi, na tasmiṃ sammukhībhūte pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabban ti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.5.1: kathaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhātako tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
pli-tv-kd19:3.5.2: idha bhikkhave yehi ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi sikkhā paccakkhātā hoti tehi ākārehi tehi liṅgehi tehi nimittehi bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati sikkhaṃ paccakkhantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd19:3.5.3: na h' eva kho bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati sikkhaṃ paccakkhantaṃ, api c' añño bhikkhu bhikkhussa āroceti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.5.5: na h' eva kho bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati sikkhaṃ paccakkhantaṃ, nāpi añño bhikkhu bhikkhussa āroceti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.5.6: itthannāmena āvuso bhikkhunā sikkhā paccakkhātā 'ti, api ca so 'va bhikkhussa āroceti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.5.8: ākaṅkhamāno bhikkhave bhikkhu tena diṭṭhena tena sutena tāya parisaṅkāya tadah' uposathe cātuddase vā pannarase vā tasmiṃ puggale sammukhībhūte saṃghamajjhe udāhareyya:
pli-tv-kd19:3.5.10: itthannāmena puggalena sikkhā paccakkhātā, tassa pātimokkhaṃ ṭhapemi, na tasmiṃ sammukhībhūte pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabban ti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.5.12: bhikkhussa pātimokkhe ṭhapite parisā vuṭṭhāti dasannaṃ antarāyānaṃ aññatarena,
pli-tv-kd19:3.5.14: brahmacariyantarāyena vā. ākaṅkhamāno bhikkhave bhikkhu tasmiṃ āvāse aññatarasmiṃ vā āvāse tasmiṃ puggale sammukhībhūte saṃghamajjhe udāhareyya:
pli-tv-kd19:3.5.16: itthannāmassa puggalassa sikkhaṃ paccakkhātakathā vippakatā, taṃ vatthuṃ avinicchitaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:3.5.17: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho taṃ vatthuṃ vinicchineyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:3.5.18: evañ ce taṃ labhetha icc etaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-kd19:3.5.19: no ce labhetha tadah' uposathe cātuddase vā pannarase vā tasmiṃ puggale sammukhībhūte saṃghamajjhe udāharitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:3.5.21: itthannāmassa puggalassa sikkhaṃ paccakkhātakathā vippakatā, taṃ vatthuṃ avinicchitaṃ,
pli-tv-kd19:3.5.22: tassa pātimokkhaṃ ṭhapemi, na tasmiṃ sammukhībhūte pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabban ti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.6.2: idha bhikkhave yehi ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi dhammikāya sāmaggiyā anupagamanaṃ hoti tehi ākārehi tehi liṅgehi tehi nimittehi bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati dhammikaṃ sāmaggiṃ na upentaṃ,
pli-tv-kd19:3.6.3: na h' eva kho bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati dhammikaṃ sāmaggiṃ na upentaṃ, api ca añño bhikkhu bhikkhussa āroceti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.6.4: itthannāmo āvuso bhikkhu dhammikaṃ sāmaggiṃ na upetīti,
pli-tv-kd19:3.6.5: na h' eva kho bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati dhammikaṃ sāmaggiṃ na upentaṃ, nāpi añño bhikkhu bhikkhussa āroceti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.6.6: itthannāmo āvuso bhikkhu dhammikaṃ sāmaggiṃ na upetīti, api ca so 'va bhikkhussa āroceti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.6.7: ahaṃ āvuso dhammikaṃ sāmaggiṃ na upemīti.
pli-tv-kd19:3.6.8: ākaṅkhamāno bhikkhave bhikkhu tena diṭṭhena tena sutena tāya parisaṅkāya tadah' uposathe cātuddase vā pannarase vā tasmiṃ puggale sammukhībhūte saṃghamajjhe udāhareyya:
pli-tv-kd19:3.6.10: itthannāmo puggalo dhammikaṃ sāmaggiṃ na upeti, tassa pātimokkhaṃ ṭhapemi, na tasmiṃ sammukhībhūte pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabban ti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.7.2: idha bhikkhave yehi ākārehi . . . nimittehi dhammikāya sāmaggiyā paccādānaṃ hoti tehi ākārehi . . . nimittehi bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati dhammikaṃ sāmaggiṃ paccādiyantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd19:3.7.7: itthannāmo puggalo dhammikaṃ sāmaggiṃ paccādiyati, tassa pātimokkhaṃ ṭhapemi, na tasmiṃ sammukhībhūte pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabban ti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.7.20: na tasmiṃ sammukhībhūte pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabban ti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.8.2: idha bhikkhave yehi ākārehi . . . nimittehi sīlavipattiyā diṭṭhasutaparisaṅkito hoti tehi ākārehi . . . nimittehi bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati sīlavipattiyā diṭṭhasutaparisaṅkitaṃ,
pli-tv-kd19:3.8.3: na h' eva kho bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati sīlavipattiyā diṭṭhasutaparisaṅkitaṃ, api ca añño bhikkhu bhikkhussa āroceti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.8.5: na h' eva kho bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ passati sīlavipattiyā diṭṭhasutaparisaṅkitaṃ nāpi añño bhikkhu bhikkhussa āroceti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.8.6: itthannāmo āvuso bhikkhu sīlavipattiyā diṭṭhasutaparisaṅkito 'ti, api ca so 'va bhikkhussa āroceti:
pli-tv-kd19:3.8.8: ākaṅkhamāno bhikkhave bhikkhu tena diṭṭhena . . . udāhareyya:
pli-tv-kd19:3.8.10: itthannāmo puggalo sīlavipattiyā diṭṭhasutaparisaṅkito, tassa pātimokkhaṃ ṭhapemi, na tasmiṃ sammukhībhūte pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabban ti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.1: atha kho āyasmā Upāli yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Upāli bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.3: attādānaṃ ādātukāmena bhante bhikkhunā kataṅgasamannāgataṃ attādānaṃ ādātabban ti.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.4: attādānaṃ ādātukāmena Upāli bhikkhunā pañcaṅgasamannāgataṃ attādānaṃ ādātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.5: attādānaṃ ādātukāmena Upāli bhikkhunā evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.6: yaṃ kho ahaṃ imaṃ attādānaṃ ādātukāmo, kālo nu kho imaṃ attādānaṃ ādātuṃ udāhu no 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.7: sace Upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.8: akālo imaṃ attādānaṃ ādātuṃ no kālo 'ti, na taṃ Upāli attādānaṃ ādātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.9: sace pana Upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.10: kālo imaṃ attādānaṃ ādātuṃ no akālo 'ti, ten' Upāli bhikkhunā uttariṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.11: yaṃ kho ahaṃ imaṃ attādānaṃ ādātukāmo, bhūtaṃ nu kho idaṃ attādānaṃ udāhu no 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.12: sace Upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.13: abhūtaṃ idaṃ attādānaṃ no bhūtan ti, na taṃ Upāli attādānaṃ ādātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.14: sace pana Upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.15: bhūtaṃ idaṃ attādānaṃ no abhūtan ti, ten' Upāli bhikkhunā uttariṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.16: yaṃ kho ahaṃ imaṃ attādānaṃ ādātukāmo, atthasaṃhitaṃ nu kho idaṃ attādānaṃ udāhu no 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.17: sace Upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.18: anatthasaṃhitaṃ idaṃ attādānaṃ no atthasaṃhitan ti, na taṃ Upāli attādānaṃ ādātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.19: sace pana Upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.20: atthasaṃhitaṃ idaṃ attādānaṃ no anatthasaṃhitan ti, ten' Upāli bhikkhunā uttariṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.21: imaṃ kho ahaṃ attādānaṃ ādiyamāno labhissāmi sandiṭṭhe sambhatte bhikkhū dhammato vinayato pakkhe udāhu no 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.22: sace Upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.23: imaṃ kho ahaṃ attādānaṃ ādiyamāno na labhissāmi sandiṭṭhe sambhatte bhikkhū dhammato vinayato pakkhe 'ti, na taṃ Upāli attādānaṃ ādātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.24: sace pana Upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.25: imaṃ kho ahaṃ attādānaṃ ādiyamāno labhissāmi sandiṭṭhe sambhatte bhikkhū dhammato vinayato pakkhe 'ti, ten' Upāli bhikkhunā uttariṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.26: imaṃ kho me attādānaṃ ādiyato bhavissati saṃghassa tatonidānaṃ bhaṇḍanaṃ kalaho viggaho vivādo saṃghabhedo saṃgharāji saṃghavavatthānaṃ saṃghanānākaraṇaṃ udāhu no 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.27: sace Upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.28: imaṃ kho me attādānaṃ ādiyato bhavissati saṃghassa tatonidānaṃ bhaṇḍanaṃ . . . saṃghanānākaraṇan ti, na taṃ Upāli attādānaṃ ādātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.29: sace pana Upāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.30: imaṃ kho me attādānaṃ ādiyato na bhavissati saṃghassa tatonidānaṃ bhaṇḍanaṃ . . . saṃghanānākaraṇan ti, ādātabbaṃ taṃ Upāli attḥÅānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd19:4.1.31: evaṃ pañcaṅgasamannāgataṃ kho Upāli attādānaṃ ādinnaṃ pacchā avippaṭisārakaraṃ bhavissatīti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.1: codakena bhante bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena kati dhamme ajjhattaṃ paccavekkhitvā paro codetabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.2: codakena Upāli bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ paccavekkhitvā paro codetabbo:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.3: codakena Upāli bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.4: parisuddhakāyasamācāro nu kho 'mhi parisuddhen' amhi kāyasamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena, saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu no 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.5: no ce Upāli bhikkhu parisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhena kāyasamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena, tassa bhavanti vattāro:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.6: iṅgha tāva āyasmā kāyikaṃ sikkhassū 'ti, iti 'ssa bhavanti vattāro.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.7: puna ca paraṃ Upāli codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.8: parisuddhavacīsamācāro nu kho 'mhi parisuddhen' amhi vacīsamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena, saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu no 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.9: no ce Upāli bhikkhu parisuddhavacīsamācāro hoti parisuddhena vacīsamācārena samannāgato
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.11: iṅgha tāva āyasmā vācasikaṃ sikkhassū 'ti, iti 'ssa bhavanti vattāro.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.12: puna ca paraṃ Upāli codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.13: mettaṃ nu kho me cittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ sabrahmacārīsu anāghātaṃ, saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu no 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.14: no ce Upāli bhikkhuno mettacittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sabrahmacārīsu anāghātaṃ, tassa bhavanti vattāro:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.15: iṅgha tāva āyasmā sabrahmacārīsu mettacittaṃ upaṭṭhāpehīti, iti 'ssa bhavanti vattāro.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.16: puna ca paraṃ Upāli codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.17: bahussuto nu kho 'mhi sutadharo sutasannicayo, ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhe kalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti tathārūpā me dhammā bahussutā dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā, saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu no 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.18: no ce Upāli bhikkhu bahussuto hoti sutadharo . . . tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā, tassa bhavanti vattāro:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.19: iṅgha tāva āyasmā āgamaṃ pariyāpuṇassū 'ti, iti 'ssa bhavanti vattāro.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.20: puna ca paraṃ Upāli codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.21: ubhayāni nu kho me pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttato anuvyañjanaso, saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu no 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.22: no ce Upāli bhikkhuno ubhayāni pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni . . . anuvyañjanaso, idaṃ panāvuso kattha vuttaṃ bhagavatā 'ti iti puṭṭho na sampāyati , tassa bhavanti vattāro:
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.23: iṅgha tāva āyasmā vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇassū 'ti, iti 'ssa bhavanti vattāro.
pli-tv-kd19:5.1.24: codakena Upāli bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ paccavekkhitvā paro codetabbo 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd19:5.2.1: codakena bhante bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena kati dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paro codetabbo 'ti. codakena
pli-tv-kd19:5.2.2: Upāli bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paro codetabbo:
pli-tv-kd19:5.2.8: Upāli bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paro codetabbo 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd19:5.3.1: adhammacodakassa bhante bhikkhuno katīh' ākārehi vippaṭisāro upadahātabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.3.2: adhammacodakassa Upāli bhikkhuno pañcah' ākārehi vippaṭisāro upadahātabbo.
pli-tv-kd19:5.3.3: akālenāyasmā codesi no kālena alan te vippaṭisārāya,
pli-tv-kd19:5.3.4: abhūtenāyasmā codesi no bhūtena alan te vippaṭisārāya,
pli-tv-kd19:5.3.7: dosantaro āyasmā codesi no mettacitto alan te vippaṭisārāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.3.8: adhammacodakassa Upāli bhikkhuno imehi pañcah' ākārehi vippaṭisāro upadahātabbo.
pli-tv-kd19:5.3.10: yathā na añño pi bhikkhu abhūtena codetabbaṃ maññeyyā 'ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd19:5.4.1: adhammacuditakassa pana bhante bhikkhuno katīh' ākārehi avippaṭisāro upadahātabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.4.2: adhammacuditakassa Upāli bhikkhuno pañcah' ākārehi avippaṭisāro upadahātabbo:
pli-tv-kd19:5.4.7: dosantarenāyasmā cudito no mettacittena alan te avippaṭisārāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.4.8: adhammacuditakassa Upāli bhikkhuno imehi pañcah' ākārehi avippaṭisāro upadahātabbo 'ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd19:5.5.1: dhammacodakassa bhante bhikkhuno katīh' ākārehi avippaṭisāro upadahātabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.5.2: dhammacodakassa Upāli bhikkhuno pañcah' ākārehi avippaṭisāro upadahātabbo:
pli-tv-kd19:5.5.7: mettacitto āyasmā codesi no dosantaro alan te avippaṭisārāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.5.8: dhammacodakassa Upāli bhikkhuno imehi pañcah' ākārehi avippaṭisāro upadahātabbo.
pli-tv-kd19:5.5.10: yathā añño pi bhikkhu bhūtena codetabbaṃ maññeyyā 'ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd19:5.6.1: dhammacuditakassa pana bhante bhikkhuno katīh' ākārehi vippaṭisāro upadahātabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.6.2: dhammacuditakassa Upāli bhikkhuno pañcah' ākārehi vippaṭisāro upadahātabbo:
pli-tv-kd19:5.6.7: mettacittenāyasmā cudito no dosantarena alan te vippaṭisārāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.6.8: dhammacuditakassa Upāli bhikkhuno imehi pañcah' ākārehi vippaṭisāro upadahātabbo 'ti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd19:5.7.1: codakena bhante bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena kati dhamme ajjhattaṃ manasikatvā paro codetabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.7.2: codaken' Upāli bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ manasikaritvā paro codetabbo:
pli-tv-kd19:5.7.3: kāruññatā hitesitā anukampatā āpattivuṭṭhānatā vinayapurekkhāratā. codakena
pli-tv-kd19:5.7.4: Upāli bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ manasikaritvā paro codetabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.7.5: cuditena pana bhante bhikkhunā katīsu dhammesu patiṭṭhātabban ti.
pli-tv-kd19:5.7.6: cuditen' Upāli bhikkhunā dvīsu dhammesu patiṭṭhātabbaṃ
